overall.basis: No overall dimension is printed. W x D TRACED from the main-floor outline (723 x 578 px) at 9.61 px/ft, the scale from printed whole-foot room labels (MSTR SUITE 16' x 18', 2-CAR GARAGE 20' x 21', DINING 12' x 13', LIVING 12' x 15' give 9.56-9.67 px/ft; +/-2 %). Closed body = conditioned main floor + enclosed garage/shop: master-wing left wall to shop right wall; foyer front wall to garage rear wall. Entry porch, veranda, rear patio and the living-room chimney excluded. Front = bottom of the plans (entry porch/foyer), matching the render captioned 'front exterior'. Published Width 74' 10" (22.81 m) is within 0.5 % of the traced 22.93; published Depth 63' 10" (19.46 m) equals, at this scale, the depth from the garage rear wall to the face of the entry-porch columns (19.46 m), i.e. the published depth includes the entry porch; the closed body is 18.33. heightM = published Height 28' 0" (no elevation).

mainRoof.notes: From the front render only: red clay barrel-tile hip roofs throughout, wide plain eaves. Main two-storey roof hipped with its ridge parallel to the front (complex, with cross hips to the right); separate lower hip over the one-storey master wing at left and a low hipped roof at the far right (util/garage side); the entry portico has its own roof projecting forward (exact form not clear); one tall stucco chimney with cap rises above the front. Rear and garage roofs not seen; the upper plan draws the one-storey and garage roof outlines dashed only. Pitch not shown.
